topic: MBBS in Russia fees 2026 for Indian students
title: MBBS in Russia Fees 2026: Complete Cost Guide for Indians
intro: Pursuing MBBS in Russia costs between ₹15-40 lakhs for the complete 6-year program, making it one of the most affordable destinations for Indian medical students. This comprehensive guide breaks down all expenses including tuition, hostel, and living costs for 2026 admissions.
